$comment: HAND-EDITED. The agent chat transcript's look tokens and the named looks built from them (docs/cmux-next/transcript-customization.md). cmux-config (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-config/src/transcript_look.rs) embeds this file: it checks agentPane.display.transcriptTokens and every look here, and resolves a look plus overrides into token values. The chat page (webviews/src/agent-session/acpmux/conversation/transcriptLook.ts) imports the same file and draws the resolved values as CSS custom properties. A token is a choice (choices) or a number (min, max, unit). A look sets any subset of the tokens: a token a look leaves out keeps the chat's own default (the stylesheet value, or the Agent Chat setting the person set). The cmux look (the default) sets none, so it is the chat as it draws today.

tokens.name: density
tokens.description: How far apart the transcript's rows sit: compact draws the grid's gaps at 0.75, cozy at 1, comfortable at 1.25.

tokens.name: rowSpacing
tokens.description: A further scale on every gap between rows, times density's.

tokens.name: messageWidth
tokens.description: The widest the chat's column gets. agentPane.display.width, when set, wins.

tokens.name: font
tokens.description: The text face. agentPane.display.font.preset, when set, wins.

tokens.name: fontSize
tokens.description: The text size. agentPane.display.font.size, when set, wins.

tokens.name: lineHeight
tokens.description: The line height, times the text size. agentPane.display.font.lineHeight, when set, wins.

tokens.name: reply.font
tokens.description: The agent's reply prose face: the interface sans, a system serif or the code face. Code and the reply's chrome keep theirs. Unset, the reply draws in the chat's face. A font pack's prose family wins; agentPane.display.font.preset, when you set it, wins over a look's value.

tokens.name: reply.fontSize
tokens.description: The agent's reply prose size, on lines of lineHeight times it. Unset, the chat's text size. agentPane.display.font.size, when you set it, wins over a look's value.

tokens.name: userMessage.font
tokens.description: Your messages' face. Unset, the chat's face. agentPane.display.font.preset, when you set it, wins over a look's value.

tokens.name: userMessage.fontSize
tokens.description: Your messages' size, on lines of lineHeight times it. Unset, the chat's text size. agentPane.display.font.size, when you set it, wins over a look's value.

tokens.name: userMessage.style
tokens.description: Your messages: a filled bubble, or plain text with a rule at its leading edge.

tokens.name: userMessage.align
tokens.description: Which side of the column your messages sit on.

tokens.name: userMessage.maxWidth
tokens.description: The widest your message gets, as a share of the column.

tokens.name: userMessage.radius
tokens.description: The bubble's corner radius.

tokens.name: userMessage.paddingBlock
tokens.description: The space above and below the text inside the bubble.

tokens.name: userMessage.paddingInline
tokens.description: The space beside the text inside the bubble.

tokens.name: userMessage.fill
tokens.description: How much of the text color the bubble's fill mixes in: 0 is no fill.

tokens.name: toolCard.radius
tokens.description: The corner radius of the cards in the transcript: tool output, errors, plans, questions. Unset, each kind of card keeps its own (6 to 12).

tokens.name: toolCard.border
tokens.description: Whether those cards draw a hairline edge.

tokens.name: toolCards
tokens.description: How a run of tool calls draws: one-line rows with icons, the rows on a card, or quiet rows with no icons.

tokens.name: codeCard.radius
tokens.description: The corner radius of code blocks.

tokens.name: timestamps
tokens.description: When a message's time shows: on hover, always, or never.

looks.name: cmux
looks.title: cmux
looks.description: The chat as cmux draws it: the default.

looks.name: claude
looks.title: Claude
looks.description: Room to read: a narrower column, replies in a serif and your messages in the sans, larger text, quiet tool lines with no icons, soft bubbles and rounded cards.

looks.name: codex
looks.title: Codex
looks.description: A narrow column, a rounded bubble for your messages, borderless cards, no times.

looks.name: studio
looks.title: Studio
looks.description: Dense work logs: tight rows, a rounded bubble, small radii.
